description: This file defines the abstract base class `PdfAnnotation` for PDF annotation objects in the PDFsharp library. It includes properties and methods for handling annotation attributes like flags, rectangle bounds, color, opacity, and metadata such as title and subject. It also defines a nested `Keys` class with constants for PDF dictionary keys related to annotations.

classes.name: PdfAnnotation
classes.description: Abstract base class representing all PDF annotations, providing core properties and methods for annotation manipulation.

classes.name: PdfAnnotation.Keys
classes.description: Defines constant keys used in the annotation PDF dictionary for referencing annotation properties.

methods.name: PdfAnnotation()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing a new annotation instance.

methods.name: PdfAnnotation(PdfDocument document)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new annotation with a parent document.

methods.name: PdfAnnotation(PdfDictionary dict)
methods.description: Internal constructor initializing an annotation from an existing dictionary.

methods.name: Delete()
methods.description: Removes the annotation from its parent collection (obsolete, recommends using Parent.Remove(this)).

methods.name: Flags
methods.description: Property to get or set annotation flags.
